title: Local LLM Tools via MCP: Let Ollama Use Your Files
description:
Your local model can't touch your files yet. Here's the fix. 🔧

✅ Add an MCP server to a servers.json config
✅ Start an MCP client for Ollama with your model
✅ Run it and watch the model use a tool

Day 9 of Local AI Coding. Next up: Day 10, Benchmark Local vs Cloud on Your Code.
Follow for a new short every day and build your local AI setup.

#shorts #ollama #mcp #localai #aitools #coding #aicoding #llm
comment: Files or search: which tool would you add first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: the filesystem server only sees the folder you pass it, so start with a small project folder.
